text:
carmen: Quick postmortem follow-up. We need: short public status, a 72h customer note, and a clear policy for who gets the full RCA. Also need owners for remediation and recurrence tracking.

evan: I can write the public blurb. One paragraph + promise of 72h follow-up.

jing: I'll draft the 72h customer summary skeleton with a section on recurring-failure patterns and proposed runbook changes.

maria-legal: Legal will own the redaction checklist. Anything with customer IDs, hostnames, or raw logs needs sign-off. Full RCAs may require NDA.

support-bot: Reminder: add action items to ticket PM-780 and set due dates.

carmen: Let's make concrete AIs here. React with :thumbsup: to accept.

```
AI-821: Evan  Draft public status blurb by Tue 11:00 UTC and post to Statuspage draft.
AI-822: Jing  Deliver 72h customer summary skeleton (timeline, metrics, recurrence analysis, mitigation plan) by Wed 12:00 UTC.
AI-823: Maria-Legal  Produce redaction checklist + approval steps by Wed 17:00 UTC.
AI-824: Ops-Lead  Add remediation tasks to ops backlog and assign owners for recurrence fixes by Thu EOD.
AI-825: Support  Export impacted-customer list and tag outreach owners by Tue 18:00 UTC.
```

ev an: Accept AI-821. Posting a first-draft blurb: 

"We experienced intermittent API errors from 03:0803:55 UTC due to a database failover that caused elevated 5xx rates for some requests. Normal service resumed at 03:55 UTC after rerouting traffic and completing failover. We apologize for the disruption. A detailed summary and next steps will be published within 72 hours."

jing: Accept AI-822. I'll include a short recurrence analysis: three failovers in the past two weeks clustered around heavy write traffic and circuit-breaker tripping. Proposed mitigations: adjust backoff, limit burst size, and add health checks.

maria-legal: Accept AI-823 conditional on NDA language for full RCA distribution. Will provide checklist: redact PII, remove internal hostnames/IPs, summarize logs rather than paste.

ops-lead: Accept AI-824. I'll create remediation tickets for the proposed runbook changes and tag owners; target sprint next week.

support-bot: AI items AI-821..AI-825 added to PM-780 with due dates.

carmen: Quick decision: public blurb as Evan posted looks good; Maria-Legal to confirm wording is non-sensitive. Jing, drop the 72h skeleton into PM-780 and include a short section titled "recurrence and next steps" with recommended priority. Ops-Lead, please ensure remediation tickets link back to PM-780 so we track closure.

ev an: Will post blurb to Statuspage draft in 20 minutes.

jing: Starting 72h skeleton now, will ping when uploaded.

maria-legal: Scheduling a 15-min review for the redaction checklist tomorrow morning.

carmen: Thanks all. If anyone can't meet their ETA, flag it here so we can reassign. Closing loop: I'll verify all deliverables in PM-780 by end of day Wed.
